CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: SoFi Technologies (NASDAQ: SOFI) is the everything app for digital financial services on a mission to help people achieve financial independence to realize their ambitions. 17.1 million members trust SoFi to borrow, save, spend, invest, and protect their money and buy, sell and hold their crypto - all in one app - and get access to financial planners, exclusive experiences, and a thriving community. Banks, fintechs, and brands use innovative capabilities from SoFi Tech Solutions to serve over 140 million global accounts. For more information, visit www.sofi.com or download our iOS and Android apps.
